# Entice Innovations — LLM Reference

> Entice Innovations is a premium end-to-end digital partner for ambitious businesses.
> We deliver AI consulting, IT strategy, digital marketing, brand building, tech infrastructure, and performance marketing.

## About

Entice Innovations is a full-service digital agency based in India, serving premium clients across 12+ industries including Healthcare, Defence, Finance, Automotive, Education, Manufacturing, and SaaS.

We are not a typical agency. We operate as an integrated team — strategy, technology, creative, and growth working in parallel — not handed off between vendors.

## Core Services

- Digital Marketing — SEO, SEM, PPC, social media, content marketing, email automation
- IT Consulting — Technology audits, digital transformation roadmaps, system integration
- AI Consulting — AI readiness assessment, ML strategy, workflow automation, custom LLM solutions
- Domain & Hosting — Managed hosting, SSL, CDN, uptime monitoring
- Tech Infrastructure — Cloud architecture (AWS/GCP/Azure), DevOps, CI/CD, security hardening
- Brand Building — Brand strategy, visual identity, logo, brand guidelines, tone of voice
- Marketing — Performance campaigns, multi-channel strategy, analytics, A/B testing

## Key Facts

- 50+ premium clients served
- 150K+ leads generated
- 100K+ impressions delivered
- 7 core service disciplines
- Industries: Healthcare, Education, Automotive, Defence, R&D, Manufacturing, Finance, Retail, SaaS, Legal, Real Estate, Energy
